description: React component implementing an interactive mind map visualization with zoom and pan capabilities. It renders nodes and edges, manages layout calculations, and handles user interactions like dragging and zooming.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Constrains a number within a specified min and max range.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value to string, trimming whitespace, and handling null/undefined.

methods.name: computeLayout
methods.description: Calculates positions for nodes in a simple radial layout with center node fixed at (0,0).

methods.name: getNodeColor
methods.description: Determines node fill color based on status (center, selected, dimmed).

methods.name: getNodeStroke
methods.description: Determines node stroke color based on status.
